Name: SiIvagunner Music Replacement Pack
Author: Acebats
Description:
Requires: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043 and SMAPI

This mod replaces music in game with the tracks from https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLL0CQjrcN8D0Knnftj1XTvM0RUvSo-fk_ as of 11/07/21
All rips come from the www.youtube.com/c/SiIvaGunner/ channel.

This mod may not be completely up to date if new rips get added

Includes a version with and without the Journey of the Prarie King rip (Beta mix of violin solo is in a different zip, just replace violin.wav in the original zip with the one found in the "Violin Beta Mix Replacement" folder

All remixes used are created by contributors to SiIlvagunner, in some situations the original ripper is unknown, all tracks used following the guidelines found on the about page https://www.youtube.com/c/SiIvaGunner/about (This mod is not and will not ever be monitised, full credit is given to the SiIvagunner team and their contributors where possible)

Downloads.Description:
Extract in Mods folder, this version includes Lady - Yankin, there is an alternate download under Miscellaneous which does not include this track
Violin Beta Mix is found in alternate downloads
Replace violin.wav in the mod folder with this file to use the Violin Solo (Beta Mix) version
